probes.description: FORM P5-T7: the sample's experience `warehouse` has device `both`, so it is installable. GET /x/warehouse/manifest.webmanifest answers the web app manifest (start_url and scope /x/warehouse/, display standalone, four icon entries), GET /x/warehouse/icon-192.png and icon-512.png answer the PNGs the generator wrote at generation time, and an unknown experience is 404 for the manifest and for an icon. The ordinary client-file rule (/x/<experience>/<file.ext>) must not swallow these routes. No service worker is involved: installable only, offline is MOB-2.

steps.name: the manifest of an installable experience is served without data
an unknown experience has no manifest
an unknown experience has no icon
